source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of evaluating sources (PDF 185).

blocks.text: Information sources ko evaluate karna (parakhna) hamein yeh tay karne mein madad deta hai ke jo maloomat hum istemal kar rahe hain woh durust (accurate) aur bharose ke qabil (trustworthy) hai ya nahi. Is amal ke kai aham qadam hain, jo agle hisson (7.4.1.1 se 7.4.1.7) mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Information sources parakhne ke aham qadam kya hain? (Short question 5)
blocks.explanation: 1) Source evaluation: dekhein maloomat kahan se aayi (jaise sarkari website). 2) Credibility: kya likhne wala mahir ya ikhtiyar wala hai (jaise chand ke liye Hilal Committee). 3) Data provenance: data kahan se aaya aur kaise badla. 4) Primary sources: asal mawad ko tarjeeh dein. 5) Critical thinking: sawal karein aur mukhtalif nuqta-e-nazar dekhein. 6) Red flags: author ka naam na hona, sansani khez headlines, references na hona. 7) Bias: dekhein ke source sirf ek taraf ki baat to nahi kar raha.

items: Sources parakhna = maloomat durust aur qabil-e-bharosa hai ya nahi; saat qadam agle hisson mein.
